description: Agent logging and review enforcement directive. All agents must log significant actions and submit work for review before completion.
completion_rule: No significant work is considered complete unless it has been (1) logged, (2) reviewed, and (3) if code-related, passed both Application Review and Director Review.

application_review.description: Secondary review of implementation work. Checks UX flow, logic alignment, integration, and whether the change matches intended product behaviour.

director_review.description: Required for code changes after Application Review. Reviews architectural fit, strategic alignment, code quality, maintainability. Accept, revise, or rollback.

behaviour_manager_review.description: Monitors compliance, scores performance, links changes to prior implementations, detects regression patterns.

enforcement.tron: Orchestration and enforcement. Ensures no agent bypasses logging or review. Reports non-compliance to Behaviour Manager.
enforcement.behaviour_manager: Owns workflow optimisation. Monitors logs, scores performance, links changes to prior work, detects repeat failures, recommends refinements.
enforcement.all_agents: Must log significant actions and submit work for review before marking complete. Must include traceability to previous versions where applicable.
